Data engineering:

```{r}
cre_sf <- st_read("../data/processed/london_cre_2023_spatial.gpkg", quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(27700)

city_center <- st_sfc(st_point(c(-0.0886, 51.5145)), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(27700)
```

```{r}
cre_unique <- cre_sf %>%
  group_by(postcode) %>%
  summarize(median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  st_jitter(amount = 15)
```

```{r}
buffer_zones <- st_buffer(cre_unique, dist = 1000)
intersections <- st_intersects(cre_unique, buffer_zones)
```

```{r}
cre_unique$liquidity <- lengths(intersections)
cre_unique$local_volatility <- sapply(intersections, function(idx) {
  val <- sd(cre_unique$median_price[idx], na.rm = TRUE)
  ifelse(is.na(val), 0, val)
})
```

```{r}
cre_multivariate <- cre_unique %>%
  select(postcode, median_price, local_volatility, liquidity) %>%
  rename(
    Value = median_price,
    Volatility = local_volatility,
    Liquidity = liquidity
  )
```

Safety checks on out 3-variate dataset.

```{r}
library(moments)
kurtosis_results <- cre_multivariate %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%  
  summarise(across(c(Value, Volatility, Liquidity), ~ kurtosis(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))

kurtosis_results
```

Save the dataset:

```{r}
final_data_path <- "../data/processed/londonCRE.gpkg"
st_write(cre_multivariate, final_data_path, delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
```
